text: A Terraform auto-approve command inadvertently wiped out all production infrastructure, including the Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS).
Thankfully, they helped me restore the database, and the full recovery took about 24 hours.
To make matters worse, all automated snapshots were deleted too.
Started deploying website changes using Terraform, but I forgot to use the state file, as it was on my old computer.
All permissions are disabled. No automatic execution.
The database was fully restored, containing 1,943,200 rows in the courses_answer table alone.
It replaced my current state file with an older one that had all the info about the DataTalks.Club course management platform.
So I didn’t stop the agent from running terraform destroy
At that moment, I still believed we were cleaning up only the newly created resources.
Around midnight, I opened a support ticket about a deleted database and missing backups.
